<!--
files/cv.pdf is the PUBLIC version: pages 1-3 of the full CV only.

Page 4 of the full CV is a References section listing four colleagues with
their direct phone numbers and email addresses. That page is deliberately
excluded — publishing it would expose third parties' contact details. The
unredacted original is kept at files/cv-full-private.pdf, which is gitignored.

When updating: replace files/cv-full-private.pdf with the new full CV, then
regenerate the public copy, dropping the References page:

    qpdf files/cv-full-private.pdf --pages . 1-3 -- files/cv.pdf

Check the page range first — it will change if the CV grows past 4 pages.
-->
